heading: Willow Lake Natural Treatment System Project

tree.heading: Authorization
tree.text: The Secretary, in cooperation with the city of Salem, Oregon, is authorized to participate in the design, planning, and construction of the Willow Lake Natural Treatment System Project to reclaim and reuse wastewater within and without the service area of the city of Salem.

tree.heading: Cost share
tree.text: The Federal share of the cost of the project authorized by this section shall not exceed 25 percent of the total cost of the project.

tree.heading: Limitation
tree.text: The Secretary shall not provide funds for the operation and maintenance of the project authorized by this section.
